svg.title: SpielSpot product showcase
svg.desc: One angled window showing the actual SpielSpot homepage, framed by crisp perspective lines on a black-to-brand-green background.
svg.metadata: Source: https://spielspot.netlify.app/, captured October 19, 2026. Real product screenshot, not a feature mockup. Composition inspired by the Appwrite product-cover approach; no Appwrite assets copied.
